primaryChecks.text: For out of Jerusalem a remnant will go out, and out of Mount Zion those who shall escape. The LORD’s zeal will perform this.
primaryChecks.previousContext: The remnant that has escaped of the house of Judah will again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.
primaryChecks.nextContext: “Therefore the LORD says concerning the king of Assyria, ‘He will not come to this city, nor shoot an arrow there. He will not come before it with shield, nor cast up a mound against it.
